name: pull-request
description: Create draft pull requests from the commits on the current branch — a single PR, or a stacked chain of child PRs under a collective branch — list the GitHub pull requests awaiting your code review, and show a status board of the open PRs you authored with their review, checks and merge state. Provider-agnostic creation: full GitHub and GitLab support, honest fallback elsewhere; always previews the full PR plan before creating anything.
